responsibility: Declares the analyzer’s language/frontend integration interface. It defines the abstract translation_unit API for looking up integer constants seen by a frontend and the end-of-translation-unit hook the frontend calls so the analyzer can capture TU-specific constant values for later API modeling and diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Defines the frontend/analyzer contract by declaring the abstract translation_unit lookup API and the on_finish_translation_unit hook. Unlike analyzer-language.cc, it does not stash constants or manage the backing map; it is the interface front ends implement and call.
